comment: An agent-written inventory grid: grid centered with place-items on a radial gradient, repeat() of var() slots with spanning items, rarity colours through custom properties with var() fallbacks, ::before orbs with a glow and ::after counts from attr(), a hover scale and border transition (captured at the end). Text-heavy (boxes are the oracle): the glyph rasterization differs from Chromium's (FreeType hinting, synthetic bold outline vs bitmap dilation); the page without its text is gated at the strict metric (noText).
